name: alesa-nova-basic
description: ALESA NOVA Basic — disciplined AI coding for solo builders. Mechanical guardrails that BLOCK the classic disasters before they ship: leaked secrets, insecure defaults (RLS off, wildcard CORS, TLS verify off), catastrophic commands (rm -rf / · DROP DATABASE · force-push · curl|bash), unbacked edits, and 'done' claims with no proof. Vibe code without the disasters. Works out of the box — no jq or extra tools needed. Compliance (PDPA / ISO 27001), team / agency, and real-time supervision live in the paid editions — hello@alesa.my
